summary: CCC-era fire tower and historic cabin in Arizona's Apache-Sitgreaves National Forest, built 1933, NRHP-listed 1988; standing, staffing and visiting status not found.

facts.design: Aermotor fire tower with a 7x7 ft cab (NHLR model MC-39), with a historic cabin on a nine-acre site

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR credits the CCC with constructing the tower in the mid-1930s; Wikipedia credits the Aermotor Windmill Company with constructing it in 1933. The manufacturer and a crew may both be involved, but no source explains. The story reports both.
NHLR gives a 50-foot tower; Wikipedia gives 45.9 feet (14.0 m). facts.height_m uses Wikipedia's 14.0 m, and the story reports both figures.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The NRHP nomination PDF on NPGallery is marked not yet digitized, so the 1939 significant year and any staffing, use or closure history could not be checked. Staffing and rental status are not found in any source read; NHLR page shows no visit reports. Not read: Living New Deal (403), Heritage Index (403), Grokipedia (not used; unreliable mirror). The brief's 2452.1 m elevation matches the NHLR's 8,045 ft (2,452 m). The brief's NRHP number 87002451 is confirmed by NPGallery. The NHLR's 'MC-39' model differs from another mirror's 'MC-40', which was not used. No photos added. Worth a second pass against the digitized nomination if it appears on NPGallery later, or from the Forest Service Alpine Ranger District.
